scope: ERR-03 selection-independent merge recovery and immediate rendered-context fencing, with existing project-recovery regressions

node_regression.evidence: Actual transpiled components/hooks/callbacks with installed React static rendering and explicit state/effect/query/storage/transport/portal doubles. Includes controlled render-before-passive-effect callbacks, not an actual React scheduler or browser lifecycle.

previous_api_verification.basis: The seven API implementation/test hashes retained below match the previous checkpoint. No backend changes in the re-entry continuation.

browser_discovery.command: corepack pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/ux-recovery-followup.spec.ts --list --output <task-temp>/merge-reentry-discovery
strengthened_assertions: Reload hydrates a closed recovery entry without selection or automatic GET/POST.
Project source memberships are actually removed via isolated API; original messages remain unchanged.
All-list empty/error reads are explicit doubles, not claims of database emptiness.
Reopened title/order are original, with missing-source labels; Escape targets the entry.
Confirmed outcome is visible and focused before releasing an observed held task refresh.
Found receipt matches the original job; missing-only retry sends the identical key and payload.

implementation.recovery_owner: One existing dialog per list page outside list/selection branches; hydration while closed performs no HTTP.
implementation.selection: Fresh merge still requires two current conversations; retained recovery requires none.
implementation.context: Account/generation, effect-owned context and latest rendered open/scope all gate old actions and acknowledgements.
implementation.project_access: 401/403/404 hides retained project data and merge UI; current project key/open scope prevents cross-project opening.
implementation.focus: Shared restoreFocus callback targets the pending entry on manual close and the page result after confirmation. Callback contracts tested; physical focus remains unverified.
implementation.prior_fbk02: Old selection-count effect would close after clearing. Historical captured-callback failure did not prove a stuck rendered dialog; explicit accepted-close remains defensive.
